verdict.rationale: Asana's own app directory lists integrations offering real-time two-way sync between Asana tasks and GitLab issues (asana-intdir-13), one- or two-way sync with GitHub, GitLab, and Azure DevOps (asana-intdir-15), and Bitbucket issue/comment/assignee sync (asana-intdir-16). These appear to be marketplace listings, likely from third parties, rather than documented native Asana functionality, and the GitHub-specific listing covers only one-way PR status sync (asana-intdir-14). The API and webhooks are developer building blocks and are not credited here. Missing for 10: first-party native bi-directional sync documentation, detail on conflict handling and field mapping, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sync works.
